transcription: Main article text only (site header and menus and the sidebar '…a Process, not a Place' OFR snippet removed). The per-state allocation table (3 columns × 17 rows, alphabetical down each column) is transcribed as pipe-separated lines, one line per table row. The 'Total Electoral Votes: 538*; Majority Needed to Elect: 270*' line kept as printed, including its asterisks (the page prints no footnote text for them). Inline links flattened to their text (the years 2008, 2016, 2020 and 'political party chooses the individuals who are appointed'). Whitespace normalised.
purpose: library: how electoral votes are distributed — the allocation rule (Senators plus Representatives, three electors for the District of Columbia under the 23rd Amendment), winner-take-all versus the Maine and Nebraska district systems, split-vote history (Nebraska 2008, Maine 2016, both in 2020), the totals 538 and the 270 majority needed to elect, and the full 2020-Census per-state allocation table effective for the 2024 and 2028 presidential elections. Fits quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on state vote counts, a compare table of allocation rules, and the formula explorer for Senators + Representatives = electoral votes.
